facts.value: Receives a Fighter_GObj*, resolves its Fighter, and forwards the object to ftCo_800C5240, which accepts a non-null held item of kind It_Kind_Hammer. Only after that predicate succeeds does it test input.pressed_buttons against HSD_PAD_AB. On success it forwards the same object to ftCo_800C5D34 and returns true; otherwise it returns false without invoking the entry routine.

facts.rationale: Corrects the false universal A/B entry requirement and preserves the ordered release sequence and exceptional Fall routing.
facts.value: The input wrapper enters HammerFall when the fighter holds a Hammer and newly presses A or B, but the initializer itself unconditionally enters ftCo_MS_HammerFall and is also reached through non-input routes. Entry uses Hammer-aware frame and preservation settings, conditionally converts grounded processing to airborne processing, and runs shared Hammer setup. Animation and physics delegate to shared handlers. The release checker requires nonzero x2338.y, newly pressed A, held L/R, and x683 >= p_ftCommonData->x1C; success performs item handling with a zero vector and mode 1, calls ftCo_Fall_Enter, then performs Hammer cleanup and player/bonus notification. Ordinary Fall is the normal destination, subject to the Fall dispatcher's exceptional routes. Collision delegates a conditional handoff to HammerLanding.
